Long Description: Engineered for high-efficiency power distribution in indoor and conduit applications. Manufactured with 99.97% pure electrolytic grade copper or high-conductivity aluminum, this cable ensures minimal power loss and voltage drop. The heavy-duty XLPE or PVC insulation provides superior thermal stability, making it the ideal choice for main commercial distribution boards, internal factory wiring, and general electrification where mechanical damage is unlikely.

The backbone of industrial infrastructure. This rugged LT power cable is heavily armoured with galvanized steel wire or tape, providing exceptional resistance against mechanical impacts, crushing loads, and rodent attacks. It is specifically designed for direct burial in underground trenches, cable trays, and heavy-duty industrial plant wiring. The XLPE insulation allows for a higher continuous operating temperature of 90°C, increasing the current carrying capacity compared to standard PVC cables.

Standard Sizes: 2.5 sq.mm (Available from 2 cores up to 61 cores)
Long Description: Precision-engineered for the seamless transmission of control signals in complex industrial automation systems. With up to 61 distinct cores, these cables connect machinery, PLC panels, and measuring instruments with zero signal latency. Available in both armoured versions for hazardous plant environments and unarmoured for protected indoor control panels. Color-coded and numbered cores ensure fast, error-free installation during massive project commissioning.

Critical infrastructure demands zero downtime. Our HT Power Cables are manufactured using advanced triple-extrusion and dry-curing processes to ensure an absolutely void-free XLPE insulation layer, drastically reducing the risk of electrical breakdown under high electrical stress. Featuring extruded semi-conducting screens, these cables are designed for primary medium-voltage grid transmission, electrical substations, and powering heavy machinery in steel and cement plants.

Built to survive a minimum of 25 years under the harshest environmental conditions. Metallo Solar DC cables use flexible, tinned copper conductors to prevent oxidation and ensure maximum energy transfer from solar panels to inverters. The specially formulated electron-beam cross-linked XLPO insulation provides unmatched resistance to intense UV radiation, extreme temperature fluctuations, ozone, and water ingress. An absolute necessity for utility-scale solar parks and commercial rooftop installations.

Standard Sizes: 16.0 sq.mm (Up to 400 sq.mm for main power lines)
Max Operating Temp: Maintains circuit integrity up to 950°C for 3 hrs
Long Description: When seconds mean the difference between life and death, Metallo Fire Survival Cables do not fail. Wrapped in specialized fire-resistant glass mica tape, these cables are engineered to maintain continuous electrical supply to critical life-safety equipment—such as fire alarms, emergency lighting, smoke extraction fans, and sprinkler pumps—even while engulfed in flames up to 950°C. The Zero Halogen sheath ensures no toxic black smoke is emitted, aiding safe evacuation.

The ultimate solution for dynamic, heavy-duty applications. Unlike rigid PVC cables, these elastomeric cables offer extreme flexibility and resistance to continuous bending, making them perfect for moving machinery, cranes, hoists, and mining excavation equipment. The heavy-duty rubber compounding provides unparalleled resistance against oil, grease, harsh chemicals, mechanical abrasion, and extreme weather conditions.

Armour Type: Individual or Overall Aluminum Mylar Shield
Long Description: Designed exclusively for accurate data acquisition and process control in electrically noisy environments. These cables feature precision-twisted pairs wrapped in an Aluminum Mylar tape shield (with a tinned copper drain wire) to block electromagnetic interference (EMI) and radio frequency interference (RFI). Essential for connecting highly sensitive sensors, transmitters, and DCS systems in oil refineries, chemical plants, and automated manufacturing facilities.

The modern replacement for dangerous bare overhead power lines. Metallo Aerial Bunched Cables consist of insulated phase conductors tightly bundled around a high-tensile bare messenger wire. This design eliminates the risk of short circuits caused by falling trees or high winds, significantly reduces power theft (tapping), and is much safer for densely populated urban areas and difficult hilly terrains.

The arteries of the national power grid. Metallo EHV cables are designed for the bulk transmission of power across long distances and for connecting major substations. Manufactured in ultra-clean environments to prevent microscopic impurities in the XLPE insulation, these cables are fortified with lead or corrugated aluminum sheathing to provide an absolute radial moisture barrier, ensuring decades of fault-free transmission.

Engineered specifically to power submersible pumps deep underwater in agricultural borewells, municipal water supply systems, and industrial dewatering applications. The unique flat parallel configuration allows the cable to fit easily into narrow boreholes alongside the pump delivery pipe. The specialized water-resistant PVC or rubber sheathing prevents moisture ingress and degradation over years of continuous submersion.

The critical nervous system of railway networks. These highly specialized cables are mandated for use in railway signaling, track circuits, and interlocking systems. Manufactured strictly according to RDSO (Research Designs & Standards Organisation) guidelines, they ensure absolute reliability and zero-failure transmission of signals that govern train movements, making them vital for passenger safety and network efficiency.

Powering the future of mobility. Designed for commercial EV charging stations and portable chargers, these cables combine high-current power cores with pilot/signal cores for smart charging communication. The advanced TPU jacketing provides exceptional resistance to oil, grease, UV rays, and the severe mechanical wear-and-tear (dragging across concrete) typical in public charging environments.

The backbone of industrial and commercial networking. Metallo CAT6 cables support Gigabit Ethernet networks and high-speed data transfer up to 250 MHz. Featuring a cross-web separator to minimize cross-talk between the four twisted pairs, these cables ensure pristine data integrity for server rooms, CCTV IP cameras, and smart building automation systems. Available in Low Smoke Zero Halogen (LSZH) variants for indoor safety.

Engineered for high-frequency signal transmission with minimal loss. Metallo RG-6 and RG-11 coaxial cables feature a gas-injected foam polyethylene dielectric and a dense multi-layered shield (aluminum foil plus braiding) to block external electromagnetic interference. Ideal for broadband internet, high-definition CCTV systems, and satellite television networks requiring long cable runs without signal degradation.
